tests_cover: Standard, passthrough and future-provider virtual keys; unified client-credentials, authorization-code and future-provider OAuth clients; imports, metadata preservation, nullable clearing, no-op plans, virtual replacement/revocation and OAuth in-place rotation with rejected old secrets. unit_regressions: Failed secret rotations retain a pending nonce for retry, including combined metadata writes. Imports page through the unified list without recovering a secret. Both generated scopes distinguish nil from explicit empty routing/binding sets in parameter maps, initProvider merging and Kubernetes serialization; late initialization preserves explicit clears.
